entities.name: 2-Chloroethyl methyl ether
observations: Alkylating reagent with structure CH3OCH2CH2Cl; undergoes SN2 substitution with a suitable amine nucleophile.

entities.name: Benzoyl piperazine piperidine substrate
observations: Contains a free secondary piperidine nitrogen, an ether oxygen, and a benzoyl-protected piperazine nitrogen.

entities.name: Piperidine N-alkylation
observations: K2CO3/KI in ketone solvent promotes SN2 N-alkylation of the free piperidine NH by 2-chloroethyl methyl ether.
N-alkylation is favored over O-alkylation because the phenoxy oxygen is already an ether and the piperidine nitrogen is a free secondary amine.
